body.text: poṣadhasthāpanavastu
body.translated_text: The chapter on the suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s> (the observance day).

body.text: poṣadhasthāpanavastūddānam* /
body.translated_text: Summary verses of the chapter on the suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>:

children.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> (monk) was destroyed by <s>Maudgalyāyana</s> because of an impure <s>Poṣadha</s>;

children.text: tataḥ śāstrāṇi vigarhitvā saṃghena pṛṣṭaḥ poṣadhaḥ //
children.translated_text: Then, having censured [the use of supernatural] powers, the <s>Saṃgha</s> was asked about the <s>Poṣadha</s>.
This is the summary verse; [the full account is found] in detail in the <s>Poṣadha Sūtra</s> [set] at <s>Campā</s>.

children.text: tac ca poṣadhasūtraṃ madhyamāgame saṃgītanipāte paṭhyate //
children.translated_text: And that <s>Poṣadha Sūtra</s> is recited in the <s>Saṃgīti Nipāta</s> (Collection of Recitations) of the <s>Madhyamāgama</s> (Middle-Length Discourses).

body.text: uddānam* /
body.translated_text: Summary:

children.translated_text: Accusation (<s>codanā</s>), reminding (<s>smāraṇa</s>), and granting an opportunity (<s>avakāśa</s>), declaring non-speaking (<s>avacanīyatā</s>),
admonition (<s>avavāda</s>), expulsion (<s>prasthāpana</s>), <s>Poṣadha</s>, and invitation (<s>pravāraṇā</s>).

body.text: uktaṃ bhagavatā saṃghasthavireṇa tv ardhamāsaṃ prātimokṣasūtroddeśa uddeṣṭavya iti / upadhivārikaḥ saṃghasthavirasya purastāt sthitvā kathayati / sthavira prātimokṣasūtroddeśam uddiśeti / sa kathayati / āyuṣman na (

children.text: ) śuddhā tāvad bhikṣuparṣat* / ko 'tra sthavireṇāpariśuddho dṛṣṭaḥ / tvam eva tāvat* / katham ahaṃ sthavireṇa dṛṣṭaḥ / divyena cakṣuṣā / hantedānīṃ naṣṭāḥ smaḥ / yatra bhikṣavo divyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā codayanti smārayanti / ity etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti / bhagavān āha / asaṃvyavahāryaṃ bhikṣavo divyacakṣuḥ / tasmān na bhikṣuṇā divyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā bhikṣuś codayitavyaḥ smārayitavyaḥ / bhikṣur divyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭvā bhikṣuṃ codayati smārayati sātisāro bhavati /
children.translated_text: yet pure. Who here has been seen by the elder as impure?' 'You yourself, to begin with.' 'How have I been seen by the elder?' 'With the divine eye (<s>divyacakṣus</s>).' 'Alas, now we are ruined! [This is a situation] where <s>bhikṣus</s>, having seen with the divine eye, accuse and remind [others of offenses].' The <s>bhikṣus</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'The divine eye is not to be used in [monastic] dealings, O <s>bhikṣus</s>. Therefore, a <s>bhikṣu</s> should not accuse or remind another <s>bhikṣu</s> having seen [the offense] with the divine eye. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who accuses or reminds another <s>bhikṣu</s> having seen with the divine eye commits an offense (<s>sātisāra</s>).'

body.translated_text: It was stated by the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One) that the elder of the <s>Saṃgha</s> should recite the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> (monastic code) every half-month. The attendant (<s>upadhivārika</s>), standing before the elder of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, says: 'Elder, please recite the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s>.' He replies: 'Venerable one, the assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s> is not

body.text: yathā divyena cakṣuṣā evaṃ divyena śrotreṇa /
body.translated_text: As with the divine eye, so also with the divine ear (<s>divyaśrotra</s>).

body.text: punar apy asāv upadhivārikaḥ saṃghasthavirasya purastāt sthitvā kathayati / sthavira prātimokṣasūtroddeśam uddiśeti / sa kathayati / (

children.translated_text: [MSV III 108]

children.text: ) āyuṣmann apariśuddhā tāvad bhikṣuparṣat* / sthavira ko 'trāpariśuddhaḥ / tvam eva tāvat* / sthavira katham nāma tvayā saṃghamadhye mama śirasi muṣṭir nipātitā / aho batāhaṃ tvayā ekānte coditaḥ syām iti / sa tūṣṇīm avasthitaḥ / etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣavo bhagavata ārocayanti / bhagavān āha / ekānte codayitavyo na saṃghamadhye / saced ekānte codyamāno na smarati smārayitavyaḥ / smāritaś cet kopam āpadyate / avakāśaḥ kārayitavyaḥ / avakāśaṃ kāryamāṇo 'nyenānyaṃ pratisarati / bhagavān āha / avacanīyaḥ kartavyaḥ / avacanīyaḥ kṛtaḥ / tathāpy anyenānyaṃ pratisarati / bhagavān āha / avavādo 'sya sthāpayitavyaḥ poṣadhaḥ pravāraṇā ca /
children.translated_text: 'Venerable one, the assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s> is not yet pure.' 'Elder, who here is impure?' 'You yourself, to begin with.' 'Elder, how is it that you have brought down your fist upon my head in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>? Oh, if only you had accused me in private!' He stood silent. The <s>bhikṣus</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'One should accuse in private, not in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If, when accused in private, he does not remember [the offense], he should be reminded. If, when reminded, he becomes angry, an opportunity (<s>avakāśa</s>) should be made for him. If, when opportunity is being made, he retaliates with one thing after another, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: He should be declared non-speaking (<s>avacanīya</s>). [Even when] declared non-speaking, he still retaliates with one thing after another. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: His admonition (<s>avavāda</s>), <s>Poṣadha</s>, and <s>Pravāraṇā</s> (invitation ceremony) should be suspended.'

body.translated_text: Again that attendant, standing before the elder of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, says: 'Elder, please recite the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s>.' He replies:

body.text: ekam adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam ekaṃ dhārmikam* / dve adhārmike

children.translated_text: two unlawful and two lawful;

children.text: / trīṇy adhārmikāṇi trīṇi dhārmikāṇi / catvāry adhārmikāṇi catvāri dhārmikāṇi / paṃcādhārmikāṇi paṃca dhārmikāṇi / ṣaḍ adhārmikāṇi ṣaḍ dhārmikāṇi / saptādhārmikāṇi sapta dhārmikāṇi / aṣṭāv adhārmikāṇi aṣṭau dhārmikāṇi / navādhārmikāṇi nava dhārmikāṇi / daśādhārmikāṇi daśa dhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni /
children.translated_text: three unlawful and three lawful; four unlawful and four lawful; five unlawful and five lawful; six unlawful and six lawful; seven unlawful and seven lawful; eight unlawful and eight lawful; nine unlawful and nine lawful; ten unlawful and ten lawful suspensions of <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.translated_text: There is one unlawful (<s>adhārmika</s>) suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s> and one lawful (<s>dhārmika</s>) [suspension];

body.text: ekam adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam ekaṃ dhārmikam* / adhārmikaṃ katarat* / amūlakena kṛtena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam

children.translated_text: [Which is it?]
Suspending the <s>Poṣadha</s> with a grounded (<s>samūlaka</s>) and committed (<s>kṛta</s>)
[MSV III 109]

children.text: ) poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / idam ekam adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam ekaṃ dhārmikam* /
children.translated_text: [charge] — this is a lawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>. This is the one unlawful and one lawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.translated_text: One unlawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s> and one lawful: Which is the unlawful one? Suspending the <s>Poṣadha</s> with a groundless (<s>amūlaka</s>) and committed (<s>kṛta</s>) [charge] — this is an unlawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>. Which is the lawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>?

body.text: dve adhārmike poṣadhasthāpane dve dhārmike / katame / amūlakenākṛtenāmūlakena kṛtena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / samūlakenākṛtena samūlakena kṛtena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / ime dve adhārmike poṣadhasthāpane dve dhārmike /
body.translated_text: Two unlawful and two lawful suspensions of <s>Poṣadha</s>: Which ones? Suspending the <s>Poṣadha</s> with a groundless and uncommitted [charge], or with a groundless and committed [charge] — this is an unlawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>. Suspending the <s>Poṣadha</s> with a grounded and uncommitted [charge], or with a grounded and committed [charge] — this is a lawful suspension of <s>Poṣadha</s>. These are the two unlawful and two lawful suspensions of <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.text: trīṇy adhārmikāṇi trīṇi dhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni / katamāni / amūlakena kṛtena amūlakenākṛtena amūlakena kṛtākṛtena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / samūlakena kṛtena samūlakenākṛtena samūlakena kṛtākṛtena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / imāni trīṇy adhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni trīṇi dhārmikāṇi /
body.translated_text: There are three unlawful (<s>adhārmika</s>) and three lawful (<s>dhārmika</s>) suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s> (observance day). What are they? One who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> on a baseless charge of [an offense] committed, on a baseless charge of [an offense] not committed, or on a baseless charge of [an offense] partly committed and partly not committed — this is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. One who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> on a substantiated charge of [an offense] committed, on a substantiated charge of [an offense] not committed, or on a substantiated charge of [an offense] partly committed and partly not committed — this is a lawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. These are the three unlawful and three lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.text: catvāry adhārmikāṇi catvāri dhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni / katamāni / amūlikayā śīlavipattyā dṛṣṭivipattyā ācāravipattyā ājīvavipattyā poṣadhaṃ sthāpayaty adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / (

children.text: ) samūlikayā śīlavipattyā dṛṣṭivipattyā ācāravipattyā ājīvavipattyā poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / imāni catvāry adhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni catvāri dhārmikāṇi /
children.translated_text: One who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> on the basis of a substantiated [charge of] failure in moral conduct (<s>śīlavipatti</s>), failure in views (<s>dṛṣṭivipatti</s>), failure in conduct (<s>ācāravipatti</s>), or failure in livelihood (<s>ājīvavipatti</s>) — this is a lawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. These are the four unlawful and four lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.translated_text: There are four unlawful and four lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. What are they? One who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> on the basis of a baseless [charge of] failure in moral conduct (<s>śīlavipatti</s>), failure in views (<s>dṛṣṭivipatti</s>), failure in conduct (<s>ācāravipatti</s>), or failure in livelihood (<s>ājīvavipatti</s>) — this is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.text: paṃcādhārmikāṇi paṃca dhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni / katamāni / amūlikayā pārājikayā saṃghāvaśeṣayā pāyantikayā pratideśanikayā duṣkṛtayā poṣadhaṃ sthāpayaty adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / (

children.translated_text: (MSV III 110)

children.text: ) samūlikayā pārājikayā saṃghāvaśeṣayā pāyantikayā pratideśanikayā duṣkṛtayā poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / imāni paṃcādhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni paṃca dhārmikāṇi /
children.translated_text: One who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> on the basis of a substantiated [charge of] a <s>pārājika</s> offense, a <s>saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> offense, a <s>pāyantika</s> offense, a <s>pratideśanika</s> offense, or a <s>duṣkṛta</s> — this is a lawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. These are the five unlawful and five lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.translated_text: There are five unlawful and five lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. What are they? One who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> on the basis of a baseless [charge of] a <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) offense, a <s>saṃghāvaśeṣa</s> (remainder [requiring formal meeting of the saṅgha]) offense, a <s>pāyantika</s> (expiation) offense, a <s>pratideśanika</s> (confession) offense, or a <s>duṣkṛta</s> (misdeed) — this is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.text: ṣaḍ adhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni ṣaḍ dhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni / katamāni / amūlakena kṛtena amūlakenākṛtena amūlakena kṛtākṛtena / amūlakena kṛtena sāvaśeṣeṇa amūlake

children.translated_text: on a baseless charge of [an offense] committed with a remainder [not dealt with], on a baseless charge

children.translated_text: of [an offense] not committed with a remainder, on a baseless charge of [an offense] partly committed and partly not committed with a remainder — one who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> [on these grounds] — this is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. On a substantiated charge of [an offense] committed, on a substantiated charge of [an offense] not committed, on a substantiated charge of [an offense] partly committed and partly not committed;
on a substantiated charge of [an offense] committed with a remainder,

children.translated_text: on a substantiated charge of [an offense] not committed with a remainder, on a substantiated charge of [an offense] partly committed and partly not committed with a remainder — one who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> [on these grounds] — this is a lawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. These are the six unlawful and six lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

body.translated_text: There are six unlawful and six lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. What are they? On a baseless charge of [an offense] committed, on a baseless charge of [an offense] not committed, on a baseless charge of [an offense] partly committed and partly not committed;

children.translated_text: on a baseless [charge based on what was]

children.text: dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṃkitena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayaty adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / samūlakikayā śīlavipattyā dṛṣṭivipattyā ācāravipattyā ājīvavipattyā samūlakena dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṃkitena poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / imāni saptādhārmikāṇi sapta dhārmikāṇi poṣadhasthāpanāni /

On the basis of a substantiated [charge of] failure in moral conduct (<s>śīlavipatti</s>), failure in views (<s>dṛṣṭivipatti</s>), failure in conduct (<s>ācāravipatti</s>), failure in livelihood (<s>ājīvavipatti</s>), on a substantiated [charge based on what was] seen, heard, or suspected — one who suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> [on these grounds] — this is a lawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. These are the seven unlawful and seven lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

On the basis of a baseless [charge of] failure in moral conduct (<s>śīlavipatti</s>), failure in views (<s>dṛṣṭivipatti</s>), failure in conduct (<s>ācāravipatti</s>), failure in livelihood (<s>ājīvavipatti</s>),

These are the eight unlawful and eight lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>.

on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was both done and not done, without remainder — [in all these cases] one suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s>

body.translated_text: There are nine unlawful and nine lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s> (confession ceremony). What are they? [Suspending] on baseless [grounds] regarding what was done; on baseless [grounds] regarding what was not done; on baseless [grounds] regarding what was both done and not done. [Suspending] on baseless [grounds] regarding what was done, with a remainder [of the charge]; on baseless [grounds] regarding what was not done, with a remainder; on baseless [grounds] regarding what was both done and not done, with a remainder. [Suspending] on baseless [grounds] regarding what was done, without remainder; on baseless [grounds] regarding what was not done, without remainder; on baseless [grounds] regarding what was both done and not done, without remainder — [in all these cases] one suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s> unlawfully (<s>adhārmika</s>). [Suspending] on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was done; on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was not done; on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was both done and not done. [Suspending] on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was done, with a remainder; on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was not done, with a remainder; on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was both done and not done, with a remainder. [Suspending] on well-founded [grounds] regarding what was done, without remainder;

body.translated_text: There are ten unlawful and ten lawful suspensions of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. What are they? [The monk charged] is not [guilty of] a <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) offense. The report of a <s>pārājika</s> has not been distorted. The training (<s>śikṣā</s>) has not been renounced. The report of the renunciation of training has not

body.text: kathaṃ pārājiko na bhavati / yair ākārair yair liṅgair yair nimittaiḥ pārājikām āpattim āpadyate taṃ ca bhikṣuḥ paśyati na tair ākārair na tair liṅgair na tair nimittaiḥ pārājikām āpattim āpadyamānam* / sa cādṛṣṭvā aśrutvā apariśaṃkya poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati / adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / evaṃ pārājiko na bhavati /
body.translated_text: How is [a monk] not [guilty of] a <s>pārājika</s>? A <s>bhikṣu</s> (monk) sees that [other] monk but does not [see him] committing a <s>pārājika</s> offense by those manners, by those marks, by those signs by which one commits a <s>pārājika</s> offense. And without having seen, without having heard, without having suspected, he suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s>. This is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. Thus, [the accused] is not [guilty of] a <s>pārājika</s>.

body.text: kathaṃ pārājikakathā na viprakṛtā bhavati / yathāpi tat saṃbahulā bhikṣavaḥ saṃniṣaṇṇā bhavanti saṃnipatitāḥ / sā ca kathā na lajjā bhavati na tanmayā na viprakṛtā / te ca bhikṣavaḥ utthāyāsanebhyo nānā viprakrāmanti / sa cādṛṣṭvā aśrutvā apariśaṃkya ca poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati / adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / evaṃ pārājikakathā na viprakṛtā bhavati /
body.translated_text: How is the report of a <s>pārājika</s> not distorted? Suppose many <s>bhikṣus</s> are seated and assembled. And that report is not shameful, is not focused [on the offense], is not distorted. And those <s>bhikṣus</s>, rising from their seats, disperse in various directions. And without having seen, without having heard, and without having suspected, he suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s>. This is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. Thus, the report of a <s>pārājika</s> is not distorted.

body.text: kathaṃ śikṣā na pratyākhyātā bhavati / yair ākārair yair liṅgair yair nimittaiḥ śikṣāpratyākhyānaṃ kriyate taṃ ca bhikṣuḥ paśyati na tair ākārair na tair liṅgair na tair nimittaiḥ śikṣāpratyākhyānaṃ kurvāṇam* / sa cādṛṣṭvā aśrutvā apariśaṃkya poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati / adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / evaṃ śikṣā pratyākhyātā na bhavati /
body.translated_text: How is the training (<s>śikṣā</s>) not renounced? A <s>bhikṣu</s> sees that [other] monk but does not [see him] renouncing the training by those manners, by those marks, by those signs by which one renounces the training. And without having seen, without having heard, without having suspected, he suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s>. This is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. Thus, the training has not been renounced.

body.translated_text: How is the report of the renunciation of the training not distorted? Suppose many <s>bhikṣus</s> are seated and assembled. And that report is not shameful, is not focused [on the offense], is not distorted.

body.text: kathaṃ saṃgho na pratyākhyāto bhavati / yair ākārair yair liṅgair yair nimittaiḥ saṃghaḥ pratyākhyāyate taṃ ca bhikṣuḥ paśyati na tair ākārair na tair liṅgair na tair nimittaiḥ saṃghapratyākhyānaṃ kurvantam* / sa cādṛṣṭvā aśrutvā apariśaṃkya poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati / adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / evaṃ saṃgho na pratyākhyāto na bhavati /
body.translated_text: How is the <s>saṃgha</s> not renounced? A <s>bhikṣu</s> sees that [other] monk but does not [see him] renouncing the <s>saṃgha</s> by those manners, by those marks, by those signs by which one renounces the <s>saṃgha</s>. And without having seen, without having heard, without having suspected, he suspends the <s>Poṣadha</s>. This is an unlawful suspension of the <s>Poṣadha</s>. Thus, the <s>saṃgha</s> has not been renounced.

body.text: kathaṃ saṃghapratyākhyānakathā na viprakṛtā bhavati / yathāpi tat saṃbahulā bhikṣavaḥ saṃniṣaṇṇā bhavanti saṃnipatitāḥ / sā ca kathā na lajjā bhavati na tanmayā na viprakṛtā bhavati / te ca bhikṣavaḥ utthāyāsanebhyo nānā viprakrāmanti / sa cādṛṣṭvā aśrutvā apariśaṃkya poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati / adhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / evaṃ saṃghapratyākhyānakathā na viprakṛtā bhavati /
body.translated_text: How is the discourse of renunciation of the <s>saṃgha</s> (community) not corrupted? When many <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks) are seated together and assembled, and that discourse is not shameful, not engrossed, and not corrupted, and those <s>bhikṣus</s> rise from their seats and depart in various directions — and without having seen, without having heard, without having suspected, a [monk] suspends the <s>poṣadha</s> (observance day ceremony) — the suspension of the <s>poṣadha</s> is illegitimate (<s>adhārmika</s>). Thus is the discourse of renunciation of the <s>saṃgha</s> not corrupted.

The discourse of the renunciation of the <s>saṃgha</s> is corrupted. [The accused] has fallen from moral conduct, fallen from right view, fallen from proper conduct, fallen from right livelihood.

body.text: kathaṃ pārājiko bhavati / yair ākārair yair liṅgair yair nimittaiḥ pārājikām āpattim āpadyate / taṃ ca bhikṣuḥ paśyati na tair ākārais tair liṅgais tair nimittaiḥ pārājikām āpattim āpadyamānam* / sa dṛṣṭvā śrutvā pariśaṃkya poṣadhaṃ sthāpayati / dhārmikaṃ poṣadhasthāpanam* / evaṃ pārājiko na bhavati /

Having seen, having heard, having suspected, he suspends the <s>poṣadha</s> — the suspension of the <s>poṣadha</s> is legitimate (<s>dhārmika</s>). Thus [the accused] is not a <s>pārājika</s>.

Having seen, having heard, having suspected, he suspends the <s>poṣadha</s> — the suspension of the <s>poṣadha</s> is legitimate (<s>dhārmika</s>). Thus is the training renounced.
